title: Bot Start
effects: Launches the GridBot trading engine with the currently saved grid parameters.
The bot will begin monitoring the market and placing orders according to your configuration.
- Reads GRIDBOT_LOWER, GRIDBOT_UPPER, GRIDBOT_STEP, GRIDBOT_REF from grid_config.env
- Initializes grid tranches based on GRIDBOT_GRID_COUNT
- Starts continuous price monitoring and order management
- May place live orders if TRADING_MODE=live and I_UNDERSTAND_LIVE=YES
- Check MAX_ACCOUNT_LOSS_INR and GUARDIAN_* limits before starting
- Ensure sufficient USDT balance for grid orders
- Verify grid parameters are within safe ranges
risks: May place live orders if TRADING_MODE=live

title: Emergency Kill All

using SIGKILL (-9). This is a hard kill that does not allow graceful shutdown.

- Does NOT cancel open orders - they remain active
- Orders in flight may not be cancelled
- No graceful shutdown - state may not be saved properly
- Open orders will remain on exchange
- Consider using normal Stop instead if not urgent
risks: Destructive operation - cannot be undone
Emergency operation - use with caution

title: Clear Emergency Flag
effects: Clears the emergency flag in bot_state.json, allowing the bot to resume normal operations.
The emergency flag is set automatically when critical errors occur or manually via emergency stop.
- Bot can start accepting new orders again
- Does NOT automatically restart the bot
- Resets gatekeeper if it was blocked
- After resolving the issue that triggered emergency mode
- To allow bot to restart after manual emergency stop
- When recovering from a critical error
- Verify the root cause is resolved before clearing
risks: Emergency operation - use with caution

title: Reset Gatekeeper
effects: Resets the Gatekeeper safety mechanism that blocks trading after errors or violations.
The Gatekeeper prevents the bot from trading when safety limits are breached or errors occur.
- Clears error counters and violation records
- Bot can resume checking for trading opportunities
- Does NOT clear emergency flags (use clear_emergency_flag for that)
- Bot may resume trading if still running
- Underlying issues may not be resolved
risks: Emergency operation - use with caution
